title: cardamine flexuosa var. fallax
intro: Cardamine flexuosa var. fallax, commonly known as Alpine Bittercress, is a perennial plant that belongs to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as having anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine flexuosa var. fallax include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in relieving respiratory symptoms. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
